title: Max Consecutive Ones
summary: For a binary array, determine the highest count of consecutive one elements.
statement: For a binary array, determine the highest count of consecutive one elements.
constraints: Return the longest contiguous run of ones. Zeros break runs; no value may be flipped or deleted.
hints: The current run ends whenever a zero appears.
Keep both the current run length and the best length seen anywhere.
Increment run on a one; reset it on a zero; update best after each value.
The running maximum is needed because the longest run need not touch the last array position.
editorial: The current counter is exactly the length of the all-one suffix of the processed prefix. A separate maximum preserves earlier completed runs. This differs from Max Consecutive Ones II: that exercise allows a zero flip, while this one does not. The oracle splits a binary string at zeros.

tests.explanation: The zero separates runs of lengths 2 and 3. Return 3, not the total of five ones.
The longest run has length 2 even though the final run has length 1. Remember the best earlier run.
